title: System info definition
description: The identity of the design system. Includes name, version, organization, URL, and license. Separate from the per-entity `metadata`.

name.description: Human-readable name of the design system (ex: 'Acme Design System'). Not a package name — those belong in `extends.system` or platform imports.

version.description: Version this documentation describes (ex: '2.3.0'). SHOULD follow semver so tools can compare it against `extends.version` and `reviewedAgainst`.

organization.description: The organization that maintains the system.

url.description: URL to the system's documentation site.

license.description: License as an SPDX identifier (ex: 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0') or a URL to the license text.

hasTokenLayer.description: Whether this design system has design token. Define here to avoid tools guessing whether token entities appear in the file (tokens often live in an external DTCG file). When true, a design value that points at a token MUST be written as a DTCG alias in braces (ex: '{color.action.primary}').

platforms.description: The platforms this system documents (ex: React, Swift UI, web components). Declare them once here so the rest of the document can point at the same set instead of repeatedly defining within each block. When present, an `api` block's `platform`, an `imports` entry's `platform`, and per-platform `status` keys SHOULD each match one of these identifiers.

platform.description: One platform the system documents. `identifier` is the name everything else references; `name` is an optional friendly label.

identifier.description: The platform's identifier, unique within this list (ex: 'react', 'web-component', 'swift-ui'). MUST be lowercase kebab-case. This is the value `api`, `imports`, and per-platform `status` point at.

name.description: Optional friendly label for the platform (ex: 'React', 'Web Component', 'Swift UI').
